signatures.description: Next.js App Router onboarding rendered a sign-in fallback on the server but read role/user identity from localStorage during the first client render, causing React hydration error #418. The complete fix is deterministic prop-only initial state followed by localStorage identity and progress restoration in useEffect after mount. Apply the same rule to every sibling component mounted on the route; in EduOS, ContextualWalkthrough independently read localStorage during initial render and also had to move restoration post-mount. Add renderToString plus hydrateRoot regression tests that assert zero recoverable hydration errors and zero console.error calls, then verify a fresh production build in a browser because a stale next start process may request deleted chunks after .next is rebuilt.
